description: This file defines an abstract class 'ViewFormBase' for managing views forms in Drupal's Views UI module, including form initialization, building, display tab management, and access control.

classes.name: ViewFormBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for Views forms in Drupal, including display tab management, form building, and access control.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the form, loads include files, and sets the view entity in form state.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, ensuring display ID consistency and calling parent buildForm.

methods.name: prepareEntity
methods.description: Prepares the entity for editing by determining available displays and handling access restrictions.

methods.name: getDisplayTabs
methods.description: Generates navigation tabs for different display modes of a View, including validation error indicators.

methods.name: isDefaultDisplayShown
methods.description: Determines if the default display should have its own tab based on configuration and display count.

methods.name: getDisplayLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for a display, indicating if it has been changed.
